name: OpenShift Compatibility
description: Make devcontainer images compatible with OpenShift restricted SCC: SSH server, random UID support, fake sudo, group-writable home, optional Devsy/DevPod agent pre-install.

sshPort.description: Port for the SSH server to listen on

installDevsyAgent.description: Pre-install the Devsy agent binary (fallback if native injection fails on OpenShift)

installDevpodAgent.description: Pre-install the DevPod agent binary (legacy, kept for rollback during migration)
